description: This PHP source file defines the 'Zone' class within the Opencart admin controller event namespace. The class contains methods for handling zone-related events: adding, editing, and deleting zones, and it interacts with task models to generate or update country data. The code is part of an event-driven architecture responding to modifications in zone data within an OpenCart system.

classes.name: Zone
classes.description: Controller class handling zone-related events in the admin panel of OpenCart, including adding, editing, and deleting zones, with task generation for country info updates.

methods.name: addZone
methods.description: Generates and adds a task to update country info when a new zone is added.

methods.name: editZone
methods.description: Generates and adds tasks to update country info when a zone is edited, including handling country switching.

methods.name: deleteZone
methods.description: Generates and adds a task to update country info when a zone is deleted.
